pages.title: Graviton Wisp Core
pages.text: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of string vibrating in the mode that makes a graviton. Even out of the Wisp, it pulls gently on everything nearby. It is light, but holding it gives a faint sensation of falling toward it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Graviton Wisps drift through the Bulk, and when one dissipated it left this behind. I found more in the Calabi-Yau Knot, still faintly attracting dust.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Graviton Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Calabi Yau Knot chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Graviton Crystal.
